reconstruction_priority: tactile stop-motion puppet materials (matte clay skin, real woven tweed wool, mohair hair) — AI often replaces with generic smooth 3D CGI plastic
distinctive elongated curved puppet nose and gentle almond eyes — AI tends to normalize into standard human or round cartoon features
intricate miniature handcrafted clockwork props on workbench — AI frequently turns miniature mechanical brass pieces into illegible melted metallic noise
rich 3200K warm tungsten interior atmosphere with genuine optical bokeh — AI often introduces harsh modern digital lighting or cold HDR oversaturation
